The builder applies the following default configuration:

- Port: `6650` (see `PulsarBuilder.PulsarBrokerDataPort`)
- Port: `8080` (see `PulsarBuilder.PulsarWebServicePort`)
- Startup script: Generates a script when the container starts and runs it as the main process.
- Wait strategy: Waits until the HTTP request `GET /admin/v2/namespaces/public/default` is completed successfully.
